question: Which of the following is the largest delta in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ganges-Brahmputra__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Ganges delta, or Ganges-Brahmaputra delta, Region in **West Bengal state, India, and Bangladesh**.
 
• It is covered by the network of streams forming the mouths of the Ganges (Ganga) and Brahmaputra rivers.
 
• The **Ganges Delta** is a river delta in the Bengal region of South Asia, consisting of Bangladesh and the Indian state of West Benga
 
• It is the** world's largest river delta and it empties into the Bay of Bengal** with the combined waters of several river systems, mainly those of the Brahmaputra river and the Ganges river

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Amazon River in South America is** the largest river by discharge volume of water in the world, and the disputed longest river in the world in comparison to the Nile
 
• **The Nile is a major north-flowing river in northeastern Africa. **It flows into the Mediterranean Sea. The Nile is the longest river in Africa and has historically been considered t**he longest river in the world.**
 
• **The Congo Rive**r, formerly also known as the** Zaire River,** is the second longest river in Africa, shorter only than the Nile, as well as the second largest river in the world by discharge volume, following only the Amazon
